snippet.title: Main Menu Chill — 3 Minutes Above the Aurora | Jet Combat Simulator
snippet.description:
Three minutes of quiet Rafale flight above the clouds. The engine is at idle, the aurora is moving over the horizon, and the menu theme of Jet Combat Simulator, 'Main Menu Chill', plays all the way through. Put it on, sit back and breathe.

Recorded in-game: a real flight, replayed with the game's own sound.

Jet Combat Simulator is an indie flight game made by brothers at JBro Studio. Comment BETA if you want to fly it, and subscribe: it really helps our small studio.

#JetCombatSimulator #ChillMusic #Aurora #FlightSim #IndieGame
